summary: Build practical burnout prevention skills with ISO 45003, workload tools, and manager templates. Enrol your team today.
lede: Workforce wellbeing and burnout prevention involves identifying workload and psychosocial risks, then planning actions to reduce strain. For HR, people managers, occupational health, learning and development, and organizational development professionals, the course offers a practical approach to assessing burnout risk and addressing team strain. Learners practise workload mapping, manager response and referral pathways, psychological safety measurement, and wellbeing reporting through baselines, action plans, and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to diagnose burnout risk, improve workload balance, and report wellbeing actions with confidence.
prerequisites: Participants should have experience in HR, people management, learning and development, occupational health, organizational development, or employee relations. A working knowledge of workplace policies, team performance processes, and basic reporting is helpful. No coding or programming is required. If your organization already uses pulse surveys, absence data, or engagement dashboards, bring sample outputs if available, though the course also works with provided templates and case materials.
